verdict.rationale: Supabase is a data platform, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis. However, the pack documents no first-party retention policy, TTL, or deletion-control feature. Daily backups, Cron (a building block for user-built purge jobs), self-hosting, and region selection (residency) are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
